items.name: Required course textbook
items.explanation: You need it to study. You can still save by buying used or borrowing from the library.

items.name: Third streaming subscription
items.explanation: Entertainment is nice to have, and one subscription is usually enough.

items.name: Weekly groceries
items.explanation: Basic food keeps you healthy and able to study.

items.name: Designer sneakers
items.explanation: Shoes are a need, but a designer pair is a want. A regular pair does the same job.

items.name: Monthly bus pass
items.explanation: Getting to class and work is essential.

items.name: Daily café latte
items.explanation: Small daily treats add up fast. Coffee made at home costs far less.

items.name: Hostel rent
items.explanation: A safe place to live is one of the most important needs.

items.name: Latest phone upgrade
items.explanation: If your current phone works, an upgrade can wait and be planned as a savings goal.

items.name: Weekend concert ticket
items.explanation: Fun is important too. Pay for it from your wants budget, not your rent money.

delayRules.title: Wait 48 hours
delayRules.text: If you still want it after two days, it is more than an impulse.

delayRules.title: Count it in hours
delayRules.text: Divide the price by what you earn per hour. Is it worth that much of your time?

delayRules.title: Check your wants budget
delayRules.text: Only buy if the price fits in what is left for wants this month.

delayRules.title: Make it a goal
delayRules.text: Big wants become savings goals. Plan them instead of cutting them out.
